name: Predy Finance PredyPool lock settlement credits a supply() as repayment of take()
summary: PredyPool settles a trade lock by comparing raw token balances around the locker's callback. take() pays the locker without recording a debt and supply() is reachable inside the callback, so the attacker registered a pair, took the pool's WETH and USDC in a zero-size trade, supplied them back to mint itself supply tokens, then withdrew everything.
notes: Reset: the implementation installed at block 204572392 was rolled back at 204578244 and reinstalled by this upgrade, the change that survived to the exploit; the later storage change before the exploit is the vault counter.
The pool held exactly these balances one block before and none after; the attacker contract was created in the exploit transaction, so no drained amount is attacker capital.
